title: ulmus procera var. viminalis
intro: Ulmus procera var. viminalis, commonly known as the common weeping elm or weeping wych elm, is a variety of the elm tree native to Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Ulmus procera var. viminalis include relieving symptoms of bronchitis, coughs, and colds, while its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant's health benefits include supporting cardiovascular health and acting as an immune system booster.
